Population increased in Ceredigion

The estimated population of Ceredigion in 2024 was 72,599 usual residents, a rise of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that Ceredigion's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Ceredigion increased by 2.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Ceredigion was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Ceredigion

The average (median) age fell to 47.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Ceredigion has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Ceredigion is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Ceredigion's population of 72,599 usual residents was made up of:

  • 10,053 people aged 0 to 15 years, (13.8%)
  • 43,387 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.8%)
  • 19,159 people aged 65 years and over, (26.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Ceredigion has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (26.4% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Ceredigion, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from births and deaths.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Ceredigion
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Ceredigion, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 377 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 547 births and 924 deaths in Ceredigion.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 155 (0.2%). There were 5,144 people entering the area and 4,989 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Ceredigion's population of 338 (0.5%) as a result of 800 people entering the area and 462 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Ceredigion was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Ceredigion in mid-2023 is 72,488.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 88 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 650 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 562 people.
